fl-personal-pet.title: Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission, Wildlife as a Personal Pet
fl-personal-pet.note: FWC's no-permit personal-pet list names domestic ferrets, European ferrets, hedgehogs, sugar gliders, gerbils, hamsters, guinea pigs, prairie dogs, chinchillas, and common cage birds. Native wildlife is never a personal pet.

FL.quote: No permit is needed to possess the following species as a personal pet: ... domestic ferrets, European ferrets ...

PA.quote: Exotic wildlife includes, but is not limited to, all bears, coyotes, lions, tigers, leopards, jaguars, cheetahs, cougars, wolves and any crossbreed of these animals.
PA.note: The ferret is not in that definition and is not game. Pennsylvania treats the domestic ferret as a pet, not as exotic wildlife.

WI.note: Chapter 169's harmful-wild-animal list is cougars, bears and swine. Domestic ferret is outside that chapter's pet ban.

UT.note: Domestic ferret is not a controlled mammal on Table 3b-1. Controlled rows are the named wild carnivores, primates and the like.

WI.note: Sugar glider is a non-native mammal and is not a harmful wild animal under § 169.11.

FL.quote: No permit is needed to possess the following species as a personal pet: ... hamsters ...
No permit is needed to possess the following species as a personal pet: ... gerbils ...

NYC.note: Domesticated rodents are allowed. The large-rodent ban does not name gerbils.

FL.quote: No permit is needed to possess the following species as a personal pet: ... chinchillas ...
No permit is needed to possess the following species as a personal pet: ... guinea pigs ...

NYC.note: NYC's prohibited list names Pythonidae, Boidae, Iguanidae and venomous taxa. Thamnophis is not on the named families. The closed allowed-pet list also does not name garter snakes. Do not colour this legal or banned until 161.01 is read against Colubridae.
